items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Bill Hageman and Jack Carter, Barry Jansett, there's only two of us living.

ctx.x: New York singing syncopated Jack Carter, Will Hageman. You know Bill Hageman, don't you? Why name? Bill Hageman and Jack Carter, Barry Jansett, there's only two of us living. Now, I was the piano player myself. Jack Carter, you know, died. What did he play? Drums. Drums. Sand, dance. You know what was amusing about that job? We had two Filipinas with us. There was six of us.
This was the job in Shanghai?
